params.body:
## Summary

- On 2026-09-15 the media sync `rclone copy`'d only `vehicles/`, missing `dealers/`, `dealer_attachments/`, `dealer_backgrounds/`, `default/`, `requirements/` and `usefullinks/`, which also live on the migration volume and each map to their own disk root in `config/filesystems.php`. The StockCars dealer logo sat on the volume but never reached the bucket, so the poster and offer PDFs had no logo and `ImageController` logged "Image source not readable".
- `CUTOVER.md` now has the loop over all folders, using the rclone flags (`--size-only --fast-list --checkers 32`) that brought a ~700k-file compare down from 1h46 to 3m42, with an explanation of why `--size-only` is safe here and what "Transferred: 0 B" means.
- Added a warning to run the derived-photo backfill (`stocklist:fotos-afgeleid`) only after all media folders have synced, both in the dagkaart and in section 2.
- Docs only, no code changes.

## Test plan

- [x] `vendor/bin/phpunit --filter 'RulesIdentity|RulesDocsBuild'` (8 tests, 15 assertions, OK)
